prompt: The spec says checkout has three steps, but the code has had two since March, and new agent sessions keep "fixing" it back.
why: Update the spec with the code so it stays the source of truth.
trap: A stale spec actively misleads agents.

prompt: Every agent session must know to use the repo's date library and never call the payments API directly. These live in a rules file at the repo root.
tells: rules file at the repo root
why: Project rules in the repo are a living spec each session reads.
trap: It holds boundaries, but it's a standing document.

prompt: Each pull request updates the feature's spec file alongside the code change.
tells: updates the feature's spec file alongside the code
why: Changing spec and code together keeps them in sync.
trap: Docs that change in a separate PR drift.

prompt: Specs live in a wiki the agent can't read, so it works from stale copies pasted into chats.
tells: a wiki the agent can't read
why: Keep specs where agents (and code review) can see them: the repo.
trap: Having a spec isn't enough if agents can't read the current one.
